headline.title: More Google reviews than the 4 nearest lash and brow salons we compared.
headline.detail: BROWZ has 2607 reviews at 4.8. That's a real advantage, but only if new clients who search find a page that turns that reputation into a booking.

summary: BROWZ has 2607 Google reviews at 4.8, and reviews praise artists who listen, take their time and keep brows natural. We compared you with the 4 nearest independent lash and brow salons, and the gap is not quality but how easily new clients can find, trust and book you.
visibility: We compared BROWZ with the 4 nearest independent lash and brow salons on Google Maps (ratings, review counts and opening hours as shown today).
lead: 2607 Google reviews at 4.8: more than 4 of the 4 lash and brow salons nearby we compared.
Reviews praise artists who listen, take their time and keep brows natural.
lose: AZIZAM is open until 10pm on weekdays; you close at 9pm.
New clients who don't know you yet compare lash and brow salons on a phone in seconds; without your own booking-ready page, your best reviews stay buried in the listing.

gaps.title: The comparison happens before anyone calls
gaps.detail: People choosing a salon look at the map, the review count and a website, then book wherever it's easiest. Being the best isn't enough if it isn't visible.

gaps.title: Your strongest story is hidden
gaps.detail: Reviews praise artists who listen, take their time and keep brows natural. But someone new only sees a star rating, not why people love you.

gaps.title: Every appointment without a follow-up is a missed review
gaps.detail: Happy clients rarely leave a review unless someone asks at the right moment. That's how bigger lash and brow salons pull ahead.

actions.title: Get a page that turns visitors into bookings
actions.why: Your reviews, treatments, hours and one-tap booking or WhatsApp on one fast page for phones.

actions.title: Ask every client for a review automatically
actions.why: A short message after each appointment keeps you ahead of the lash and brow salons nearby.

actions.title: Reply to every new review this week
actions.why: Doable today, without us: it shows new visitors a real person who cares, and they notice.

plan.title: Your new website with booking built in
plan.detail: Your treatments, team and reviews on one page, with one-tap booking or WhatsApp from any phone.

plan.title: Automatic review requests
plan.detail: A friendly message after each appointment, so happy clients become five-star reviews.

plan.title: Offers and win-back messages
plan.detail: Intro offers for new clients and gentle reminders for those who haven't booked in a while.

plan.title: Your first monthly report
plan.detail: Where you stand against the lash and brow salons nearby, and what to do next.

scenario: Someone new to Umm Suqeim wants to book an appointment this week. On Sunday evening they open Maps, see a few lash and brow salons and tap the one with the most reviews and an easy booking page. BROWZ, with 2607 reviews at 4.8, is close by, but they never get past the listing. (Illustration.)
nochange: Your regular clients keep coming back. New clients keep choosing whichever salon looks easiest to book on their phone.
